title: $1,000 in Tesla's first trading day is now worth this
caption:
Tesla started trading in 2010.
$1,000 at the first day's closing price would be worth about {growth:TSLA:2010-06-29} today (share price only, no dividends).
comment: Which company would you go back in time to buy? 👇
sources: Tesla share price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2010, Tesla sold its first shares to the public.

clip.text: Tesla lists on the stock market

scenes.say: Imagine putting in one thousand dollars on day one.
Today, that would be worth about {growth:TSLA:2010-06-29}.
